fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/api -run '^(TestSlice|TestChangeShow)' passes; go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(slice|change-show)' passes for every slice*.txtar and change-show*.txtar script. grep -n 'index.Open' internal/api/change_indexed.go prints nothing, and in internal/api/slice.go openIndex is called only on the empty-IndexPath branch. A test with ctx.IndexPath set counts index opens through projection-interface's opener hook and shows slice and change show each open the index once, through the projection, with the same answers as before. Failure case: slice outside a repository is still not_found with next rhiza init, and change show with no change set named or current is still the same usage error. Touches internal/api/slice.go, change_indexed.go and their tests. Must not change slice's or change show's text or --json output, nor the answers indexModel gives, and must not delete openIndex (01M7GFTKCA does).
fields.statement: rhiza slice (internal/api/slice.go:107-140, its own openIndex and index.Open) and rhiza change show over the index (runChangeShowIndexed, internal/api/change_indexed.go:217, its own index.Open) take their index reads (change sets, a change set's entries, the view's model) from the workspace's projection when ctx.IndexPath is set instead of opening internal/index themselves; with ctx.IndexPath empty, slice keeps its openIndex of the default path, which 01M7GFTKCA's throwaway-index-fallback removes
